symbols.name: simultaneous butterfly layer
symbols.meaning: The map that applies the two-point butterfly $H_0$ to the selected bit of each of the $d$ chunks at once.
symbols.quote: Here $d$ is the number of chunks, not the number of axes used on the transform page, and the layer is written $B_d$.

symbols.name: chunk count
symbols.meaning: The number of address chunks the layer acts on, which counts the chunks, not the axes of the transform.
symbols.quote: Here $d$ is the number of chunks, not the number of axes used on the transform page, and the layer is written $B_d$.

symbols.name: record length
symbols.meaning: The number of complex coefficients in each polynomial record stored at an address.
symbols.quote: Each address holds a polynomial record of $M$ complex coefficients; $M$ is the number of complex coefficients in a record.

symbols.name: layer exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below 1 that sets the cost $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ of the layer.
symbols.quote: The exponent $\lambda'<1$ is a fixed constant.

relations.quote: Applying $B_d$ to all $d$ selected bits is built by the [Tensor product](tensor-product.md) of the $d$ single-bit butterflies, so applying them one at a time in any order gives the same result.
The layer acts on arrays stored in the [Frame of a vertex](frame.md) on each wire.
The layer computes exactly in [Gaussian dyadic numbers](gaussian-dyadic.md), whose real and imaginary parts have power-of-two denominators, each part stored with $p$ bits after the binary point.
